title: HPC127-TAGBANK: linear classical bits via counted tagged records and an indexed exponential quantum pool

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical HPC127-TAGBANK algorithm of proof.md executing COMPLETE reference HPC-127 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. The explicit source Section13 failure sum2*2^-10+2^-20+3*2^-40 is below2^-8, stronger than its headline1-2^-7. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Fully charged time is O(2^((127/100)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Source P has actual branchwise O(n^6*2^(b0*sqrt n)) work,b0=126947/100000<127/100. Known-index tag operations cost polynomial per old bit/gate/helper. The EXPONENTIAL original quantum pool is managed by a banked indexed free list and injective live-wire descriptors; it is never scanned per gate, allocation, root or source request. Actual wire lifecycle events are poly(n)*(C_P+Qcap+H+1). Every epoch has(n+2)^20 counted basis bits processed bit-serially. Exact renumbering repairs overflow with no new error/source event at all lengths and is eventually absent. Entire prefix preparation/output-first cleanup costs poly(n)*(D+H), where D,H have the same smaller internal exponent. Exact gap53/100000 absorbs all polynomial factors into the pure target. Finite earlier lengths change only an outside constant. No QRAM or assumed cheap full clear is used.

Peak ordinary classical workspace is O(n) bits, exact growth index0. Count input/output, constant-many O(n)-bit staged operands/physical addresses/current-frame words, finite control, reusable bits/carry and loop indices. Every original label/pool/list/table/profile/decoder/return/generator record, quantum free-list head/next/virgin/ownership/descriptor array, and all large epoch values are COUNTED basis qubits. Public C_i parameters are streamed before initialization and banked afterward; no whole parameter array is staged classically. Quantum pointer lists and arithmetic are processed bit-serially. No ordinary huge free list, stack, circuit or growing measurement transcript is retained.

All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak FULL allocated quantum workspace is O(2^((127/100)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Define U=C_0+2^(dl+m)+1,A=2^16*n^2,R=2^24*n^4*U,Wrow=2^16*n^2,H=2^20*n^2*U. The original coherent pool, pending indices and all scratch fit H; R/H=16n^2 makes every H-row quantum descriptor/free-list array fit counted BIG. Full basis span B=A*R*Wrow=2^56*n^8*U, complete e=(n+2)^20 tags and RAW headers/global generation/backup give D=B*(e+1)+(A+8)*e+A+2^20*n^4. The WHOLE rounded paired physical prefix, unused owners/rows/fields/pool/padding, source temporaries and all pointer records count. Full source proves U=O(n^2*2^(b0*sqrt n)),b0=126947/100000,so D=O(n^30*2^(b0*sqrt n)),H=O(n^4*2^(b0*sqrt n)). Exact gap127/100-b0=53/100000 absorbs all polynomial factors. This is a maximum span independent of lifetime and labels, not occupancy. Pool metadata are basis arrays, never free QRAM.

All acquired DCP copies number O(2^((127/100)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Exactly one physical request executes each P request and no others. Literal Qcap=4*n*C_0+K preserves every supplier rejection, failed/recycled pairing, merge discard and batch/pool abort. Source Sections13-14 prove Qcap=O(n^3*2^(b0*sqrt n)),b0=126947/100000<127/100; its exact positive rational gap absorbs n^3 into the pure envelope. Fresh zero bank/pool wires, free-list operations, tag repair, initialization and SWAPs are charged gates/storage rather than extra DCP copies. The selected fixed schedule and LE precision remain unchanged.

All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. Decoding active tag epochs and the injective live-wire descriptor map yields the COMPLETE original logical P state/source/output law. READ/WRITE/forgetting, lazy allocation/free, exact renumbering, indexed quantum allocation/transfer/release and source SWAPs reproduce their logical channels even with arbitrary correlations/references. Extra helper outcomes are marginalized rather than added to original held-out-bit conditioning. No positive robustness, adaptive-supplier transfer or impossibility of greater robustness is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
